title: Boosting CO2 and benzene adsorption through π-hole substitution in β-diketonate Cu(II) complex within non-porous adaptive crystals
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6184-6190
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08463B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yoshinori Ikumura, Tadashi Kawasaki, Yuki Ishida, Hirotomo Usui, Sayaka Uchida, Kazuki Kamata, Mikihiro Nomura, Akiko Hori
A fully fluorinated β-diketonate Cu(II) complex enhances CO2 and benzene adsorption via quadrupole interactions. Despite structural similarity, it exceeds the partially fluorinated counterpart, emphasizing charge distribution's role in selectivity.
